        run: |

          python3 -I -B "$SLICE/ci/caller.py" proof --workspace "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --manifest "$SLICE/ci/source-manifest.json" --proof "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-native-source-proof.json"
      - name: Focused source and hosted entry controls
        timeout-minutes: 3

          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02 }}

          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01 }}
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B scripts/ci/maintained_desktop574.py seed
          --inputs scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574"
      - name: Checkout exact retained public input source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          ref: 04a4a74e16e1e1bc939ea74791bf1f1bf7b46bbd
          path: retained-public-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Seed fourteen exact public ARM input files
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s  %s\n' 'a7857658af224984065e575f6ffed8308ea85027d46eace8bda146d9033e93b3' 'retained-public-inputs/seed.py' 'a388c8c8ba8e06cb92fd2be598b86e433c4e403b6e71a0f15b1eaec381bb7300' 'retained-public-inputs/index.json' | sha256sum --check
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$HOME" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs/seed.py" --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574/context/deps"
      - name: Recover exact frozen574 archive32 inputs before original producer
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B "$SLICE/archive32.py" --policy "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive32-policy.json" --inputs "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/doctor2-frozen574-archive32"
          python3 -I -B - "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive32.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive32-policy.json" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/doctor2-frozen574-archive32" "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574/context/deps" <<'PY'
          import importlib.util,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          module,policy,inputs,cache,destination=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('held_archive32_seed',module)
          helper=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
          value=helper.policy(policy,inputs)
          helper.seed_exact(cache,destination,value)
          PY
      - name: Recover exact frozen574 archive20 inputs before original producer
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B "$SLICE/archive20.py" --policy "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive20-policy.json" --inputs "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/doctor2-frozen574-archive20"
          python3 -I -B - "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive20.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive20-policy.json" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/doctor2-frozen574-archive20" "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574/context/deps" <<'PY'
          import importlib.util,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          module,policy,inputs,cache,destination=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('held_archive20_seed',module)
          helper=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
          value=helper.policy(policy,inputs)
          helper.seed_exact(cache,destination,value)
          PY

        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B "$SLICE/archive8.py" --policy "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive8-policy.json" --inputs "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/doctor2-frozen574-archive8"
          python3 -I -B - "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive8.py" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$SLICE/archive8-policy.json" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/doctor2-frozen574-archive8" "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574/context/deps" <<'PY'
          import importlib.util,sys
          from pathlib import Path
          module,policy,inputs,cache,destination=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
          spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('held_archive8_seed',module)
          helper=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
          value=helper.policy(policy,inputs)
          helper.seed_exact(cache,destination,value)
          PY
      - name: Reconstruct pinned inputs and run offline owned native574 transaction
        timeout-minutes: 40
        env:
          JOB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.proof.outputs.job_token }}
        run: >-
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 2300s
          python3 -I -B scripts/ci/maintained_desktop574.py build
          --inputs scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574" --job-token "$JOB_TOKEN"
      - name: Native Boot fresh build pair and installed synthetic CLI lifecycle
        timeout-minutes: 37
        run: >-
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 2100s
          python3 -B "$SLICE/run.py"
          --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --base-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574"
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-native-runtime"
      - name: Retire the original owned builder after every consumer
        if: always() && steps.proof.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 3
        env:
          JOB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.proof.outputs.job_token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574/report.json" ]; then
            timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s python3 -I -B scripts/ci/maintained_desktop574.py cleanup --inputs scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574" --job-token "$JOB_TOKEN"
          fi
      - name: Retain bounded product candidates and native diagnostics
        if: always() && steps.proof.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s  %s\n' 'ed3e8605535dd7ce5cbde17f770e9b3090894f2a360dfb932b31968095609dc0' "$SLICE/ci/caller.py" | sha256sum --check
          python3 -I -B "$SLICE/ci/caller.py" retain --proof "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-native-source-proof.json" --base "$RUNNER_TEMP/desktop574" --runtime "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-native-runtime" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/product-native-public"
      - name: Upload only the bounded public evidence directory
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          name: boot-report-native-products-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 3
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/product-native-public/
